EVENING ECHO
JUL 3 1 1941

NANKING
NEWS
(Central Press Service)

Jurist Ass'n Inaugurated

The inauguration meeting of the
China Jurists' Association was held
day before yesterday at the Ger-
man-Belgian-Swiss Returned Stu-
dents' Association. Mr. Chen Yun-
wen and 100 odd other members
were present. Reports on the or-
ganization of the Association were
made by Messrs. Wang Han-chang
and Wu Kai-sheng.
The results of an election are as
follows:
Mr. Li Sheng-wu, Chairman of the
Board of Directors;
Mr. Wang Han-chang and 37 others,
Directors;
Mr. Wu Kai-sheng, Chairman of
the Supervisors' Committee;
Mr. Chang Li and 26 others, Super-
visors;
Mr. Chen Kung-po, Honorary Chair-
man of The Board of Directors;
Mr. Lin Pai-sheng and 7 others,
Honorary Directors;
Mr. Chow Fu-hai, Honorary Chair-
man of the Supervisory Com-
mittee;
Mr. Klang Kang-hu and 8 others,
Honorary Supervisors.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / JUL 31 1941 / SPECIAL BRANCH）

《晚声报》
1941年7月31日

南京
新闻
（中央通讯社）

法学家协会成立

中国法学家协会成立大会于前日在德比瑞归国同学会举行。陈云文先生及其他一百余名会员出席。王汉昌先生和吴凯生先生就协会的组织情况作了报告。
选举结果如下：
李圣五先生，理事会主席；
王汉昌先生等37人，理事；
吴凯生先生，监事会主席；
张立先生等26人，监事；
陈公博先生，理事会名誉主席；
林柏生先生等7人，名誉理事；
周佛海先生，监事会名誉主席；
江康虎先生等8人，名誉监事。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1941年7月31日 / 特别科）
（批：6/31/7）
